items.informal_name: Domain Map Preserves Monomials in Monoid Algebra
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_5} {N : Type u_6} [inst : Semiring R] {f : M → N} {a : M} {r : R},
  MonoidAlgebra.mapDomain f (MonoidAlgebra.single a r) = MonoidAlgebra.single (f a) r
items.informal_description: For any function $ f : M \to N $, monoid element $ a \in M $, and scalar $ r $, applying the domain map induced by $ f $ to the monomial in the monoid algebra $ R[M] $ with coefficient $ r $ at $ a $ results in the monomial in $ R[N] $ with coefficient $ r $ at $ f(a) $. Symbolically, $ \text{mapDomain}_f (\text{single}_M(a, r)) = \text{single}_N(f(a), r) $.

items.informal_name: Domain Mapping Preserves Basis Elements in Additive Monoid Algebra
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_5} {N : Type u_6} [inst : Semiring R] {f : M → N} {a : M} {r : R},
  AddMonoidAlgebra.mapDomain f (AddMonoidAlgebra.single a r) = AddMonoidAlgebra.single (f a) r
items.informal_description: For any semiring $R$, additive monoids $M$ and $N$, function $f : M \to N$, element $a \in M$, and scalar $r \in R$, the domain map induced by $f$ sends the basis element $\delta_a \cdot r$ in $R[M]$ to the basis element $\delta_{f(a)} \cdot r$ in $R[N]$, where $\delta_x$ denotes the indicator function at $x$.

items.informal_name: Induced Homomorphism Maps Monomials via Coefficient Homomorphism
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_2} {S : Type u_3} {M : Type u_5} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : Semiring S] [inst_2 : Monoid M]
  (f : R →+* S) (a : M) (b : R),
  (MonoidAlgebra.mapRangeRingHom M f) (MonoidAlgebra.single a b) = MonoidAlgebra.single a (f b)
items.informal_description: For a ring homomorphism $ f : R \to S $ between semirings $ R $ and $ S $, the induced ring homomorphism from the monoid algebra $ R[M] $ to $ S[M] $ maps the monomial with coefficient $ b \in R $ at monoid element $ a \in M $ to the monomial with coefficient $ f(b) \in S $ at the same element $ a $.

items.informal_name: Induced Algebra Homomorphism Preserves Monomials via Coefficient Mapping
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_4} {B : Type u_5} {M : Type u_7} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : Semiring A]
  [inst_2 : Semiring B] [inst_3 : Algebra R A] [inst_4 : Algebra R B] [inst_5 : Monoid M] (f : A →ₐ[R] B) (m : M)
  (a : A), (MonoidAlgebra.mapRangeAlgHom M f) (MonoidAlgebra.single m a) = MonoidAlgebra.single m (f a)
items.informal_description: For any $ R $-algebra homomorphism $ f : A \to B $, monoid element $ m \in M $, and scalar $ a \in A $, the induced algebra homomorphism $ \text{mapRangeAlgHom}_M(f) $ maps the monomial $ \delta_m(a) $ in $ A[M] $ to the monomial $ \delta_m(f(a)) $ in $ B[M] $, where $ \delta_m(a) $ denotes the function with value $ a $ at $ m $ and zero elsewhere.

items.informal_name: Ring Homomorphism Acts on Coefficients of Basis Elements in Additive Monoid Algebra
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_2} {S : Type u_3} {M : Type u_5} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : Semiring S] [inst_2 : AddMonoid M]
  (f : R →+* S) (a : M) (b : R),
  (AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRangeRingHom M f) (AddMonoidAlgebra.single a b) = AddMonoidAlgebra.single a (f b)
items.informal_description: Given semirings $ R $ and $ S $, an additive monoid $ M $, a ring homomorphism $ f : R \to S $, an element $ a \in M $, and a scalar $ b \in R $, applying the ring homomorphism $ \text{mapRangeRingHom} $ induced by $ f $ on the additive monoid algebra $ R[M] $ to the basis element $ \text{single}(a, b) $ yields the basis element $ \text{single}(a, f(b)) $ in $ S[M] $. This demonstrates that the induced homomorphism acts by applying $ f $ to coefficients while preserving the monoid element structure.

items.informal_name: Evaluation of Multivariate Polynomial Equals Sum over Support
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] (X : σ → R) (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (MvPolynomial.eval X) f = ∑ d ∈ f.support, MvPolynomial.coeff d f * ∏ i, X i ^ d i
items.informal_description: For any finite type $\sigma$, function $X : \sigma \to R$, and multivariate polynomial $f \in R[\sigma]$, the evaluation of $f$ at $X$ is equal to the sum over all monomials $d$ in the support of $f$ of the coefficient of $d$ multiplied by the product of $X_i^{d_i}$ for each variable $i \in \sigma$. Formally, $\text{eval}_X f = \sum_{d \in \text{supp}(f)} f_d \prod_{i \in \sigma} X_i^{d_i}$, where $f_d$ denotes the coefficient of the monomial $d$.

Symbolically: $ f(X) = \sum_{d \in \text{support}(f)} \text{coeff}(f, d) \cdot \prod_{i \in \text{support}(d)} X(i)^{d(i)} $.

items.informal_description: For a multivariate polynomial $ f $ in variables $ \sigma $ with coefficients in a commutative semiring $ R $, its evaluation at a ring homomorphism $ g : R \to S_1 $ and variable assignment $ X : \sigma \to S_1 $ equals the sum over all monomials $ d $ in the support of $ f $ of $ g(\text{coeff}_f(d)) $ multiplied by the product of $ X(i)^{d(i)} $ for each variable $ i $ in the support of $ d $. Formally, $ f.\text{eval}_2(g, X) = \sum_{d \in \text{support}(f)} g(\text{coeff}(f, d)) \cdot \prod_{i \in \text{support}(d)} X(i)^{d(i)} $.

items.informal_name: Evaluation of Multivariate Polynomial with Coefficient and Variable Maps
items.type:
{R : Type u} →
  {S₁ : Type v} →
    {σ : Type u_1} →
      [inst : CommSemiring R] → [inst_1 : CommSemiring S₁] → (R →+* S₁) → (σ → S₁) → MvPolynomial σ R → S₁
items.informal_description: The evaluation of a multivariate polynomial $ p $ in variables $ \sigma $ with coefficients in a commutative semiring $ R $, where coefficients are mapped via $ f : R \to S_1 $ and variables are mapped via $ g : \sigma \to S_1 $. For each monomial term $ a \cdot \prod_{n \in \sigma} X_n^{e_n} $, the evaluation computes $ f(a) \cdot \prod_{n \in \sigma} g(n)^{e_n} $, and sums these contributions over all terms of the polynomial.

request.query: Multivariate polynomial diagonal substitution equals sum of monomials indexed by total degree

items.name: MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent_apply
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] (n : ℕ) (φ : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent n) φ =
    ∑ d ∈ φ.support with Finsupp.degree d = n, (MvPolynomial.monomial d) (MvPolynomial.coeff d φ)

items.name: MvPolynomial.sum_homogeneousComponent
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] (φ : MvPolynomial σ R),
  ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (φ.totalDegree + 1), (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent i) φ = φ

items.name: MvPolynomial.eval_eq
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (X : σ → R) (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (MvPolynomial.eval X) f = ∑ d ∈ f.support, MvPolynomial.coeff d f * ∏ i ∈ d.support, X i ^ d i

items.name: MvPowerSeries.subst_monomial
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing R] {τ : Type u_4} {S : Type u_5} [inst_1 : CommRing S]
  [inst_2 : Algebra R S] {a : σ → MvPowerSeries τ S},
  MvPowerSeries.HasSubst a →
    ∀ (e : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R),
      MvPowerSeries.subst a ((MvPowerSeries.monomial e) r) =
        (algebraMap R (MvPowerSeries τ S)) r * e.prod fun s n => a s ^ n

items.name: MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff_subst
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing R] {τ : Type u_4} {S : Type u_5} [inst_1 : CommRing S]
  [inst_2 : Algebra R S] {a : σ → MvPowerSeries τ S},
  MvPowerSeries.HasSubst a →
    ∀ (f : MvPowerSeries σ R),
      MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (MvPowerSeries.subst a f) =
        ∑ᶠ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f • MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (d.prod fun s e => a s ^ e)
